% Preamble needs: \usepackage{tikz}
%   \usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,fit,backgrounds,calc}
% Use as: \begin{figure*}[t]\centering\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{\input{fig_pipeline}}...
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\sffamily,
  b/.style={rounded corners=2.5pt, draw=black!55, fill=black!3, align=center,
            inner xsep=4pt, inner ysep=3.5pt, font=\sffamily\scriptsize, text width=27mm},
  H/.style={b, draw=red!65, fill=red!7},          % HINT lineage
  M/.style={b, draw=orange!80!black, fill=orange!12}, % MEXA lineage
  D/.style={b, draw=black!45, fill=white, dashed}, % data
  F/.style={b, draw=green!45!black, fill=green!9}, % fix
  R/.style={b, draw=blue!60, fill=blue!7},         % result
  V/.style={b, draw=green!45!black, fill=green!16, text width=24mm},
  panel/.style={rounded corners=6pt, draw=black!22, line width=0.8pt, inner sep=7pt},
  hd/.style={font=\sffamily\bfseries\footnotesize},
  eH/.style={-{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}, draw=red!65, line width=0.7pt},
  eM/.style={-{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}, draw=orange!80!black, line width=0.7pt},
  eD/.style={-{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}, draw=black!45, line width=0.7pt, dashed},
  eF/.style={-{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}, draw=green!45!black, line width=0.7pt},
  eR/.style={-{Stealth[length=2.4mm]}, draw=blue!60, line width=0.7pt}]

% ---- column x positions
\def\cA{0} \def\cB{4.4} \def\cC{9.0} \def\cD{13.6} \def\cE{18.0}

% ================= STAGE 1 : sources
\node[H] (hint)  at (\cA, 0.6)  {\textbf{HINT} repo\\\scriptsize \texttt{8dc0497}};
\node[M] (mexa)  at (\cA,-1.6)  {\textbf{MEXA-CTP} repo\\\scriptsize \texttt{b898dbb}};
\node[D] (top)   at (\cA,-3.8)  {\textbf{TOP} benchmark\\\scriptsize temporal split 2014};

% ================= STAGE 2 : defects
\node[H] (dm)  at (\cB, 1.9)  {\textbf{D3--D4} PR-AUC binarised;\\F1 fixed @ 0.5};
\node[H] (dc)  at (\cB, 0.5)  {\textbf{D5} empty criteria cache\\$\Rightarrow$ zero vector};
\node[H] (dr)  at (\cB,-0.8)  {\textbf{D7, D10} runtime\\\scriptsize patched to run at all};
\node[M] (d1)  at (\cB,-2.1)  {\textbf{D1} mechanism in a \texttt{dict}\\$\Rightarrow$ 0/264 trained};
\node[M] (d2)  at (\cB,-3.4)  {\textbf{D2} full-mask $\Rightarrow$ NaN};
\node[M] (d6)  at (\cB,-4.7)  {\textbf{D6, D8, D9} runtime\\\scriptsize patched to run at all};

% ================= STAGE 3 : harness fixes
\node[F] (f1) at (\cC, 1.9)  {ranking on\\\emph{continuous} scores};
\node[F] (f2) at (\cC, 0.6)  {threshold @\\\emph{validation}};
\node[F] (f3) at (\cC,-0.7)  {criteria cache\\regenerated};
\node[F] (f4) at (\cC,-2.1)  {mechanism registered\\(\texttt{nn.ModuleDict}) + guard};
\node[F] (f5) at (\cC,-3.6)  {trivial baseline\\+ bootstrap CIs};

% ================= STAGE 4 : models
\node[H] (mh) at (\cD, 1.5)  {\textbf{HINT} \\ 0.685};
\node[M] (mm) at (\cD, 0.2)  {\textbf{MEXA-CTP} \\ 0.674 \scriptsize(released 0.518)};
\node[R] (mg) at (\cD,-1.1)  {tuned GBDT\\XGB \textbf{0.691}};
\node[R] (mt) at (\cD,-2.4)  {zero-training\\TabFM 0.668};
\node[V] (ml) at (\cD,-3.7)  {base-rate lookup\\\textbf{0.700}};

% ================= STAGE 5 : adjudication
\node[R] (a1) at (\cE, 0.6)  {DeLong · permutation\\Wilcoxon · TOST};
\node[R] (a2) at (\cE,-0.9)  {MDE @ 80\% power\\\textbf{0.035--0.067}};
\node[V] (a3) at (\cE,-2.4)  {\textbf{Verdict}\\no difference\\is measurable};

% ================= panels + headers
\begin{scope}[on background layer]
\node[panel, fit=(hint)(mexa)(top)]        (P1) {};
\node[panel, fit=(dm)(dc)(dr)(d1)(d2)(d6)] (P2) {};
\node[panel, fit=(f1)(f2)(f3)(f4)(f5)]     (P3) {};
\node[panel, fit=(mh)(mm)(mg)(mt)(ml)]     (P4) {};
\node[panel, fit=(a1)(a2)(a3)]             (P5) {};
\end{scope}
\node[hd, above=1mm of P1] {Released artefacts};
\node[hd, above=1mm of P2] {Forensic audit (D1--D10)};
\node[hd, above=1mm of P3] {Shared corrected harness};
\node[hd, above=1mm of P4] {Model panel (phase III)};
\node[hd, above=1mm of P5] {Adjudication};

% ================= EDGES: source -> defect
\draw[eH] (hint.east) -- (dm.west);
\draw[eH] (hint.east) -- (dc.west);
\draw[eH] (hint.east) -- (dr.west);
\draw[eM] (mexa.east) -- (d1.west);
\draw[eM] (mexa.east) -- (d2.west);
\draw[eM] (mexa.east) -- (d6.west);

% ================= EDGES: defect -> fix
\draw[eH] (dm.east) -- (f1.west);
\draw[eH] (dm.east) -- (f2.west);
\draw[eH] (dc.east) -- (f3.west);
\draw[eM] (d1.east) -- (f4.west);
\draw[eM] (d2.east) -- (f4.west);

% ================= EDGES: fix -> model
\draw[eF] (f1.east) -- (mh.west);
\draw[eF] (f2.east) -- (mh.west);
\draw[eF] (f3.east) -- (mh.west);
\draw[eF] (f4.east) -- (mm.west);
\draw[eF] (f5.east) -- (mg.west);
\draw[eF] (f5.east) -- (mt.west);

% ================= EDGES: data -> tabular models & lookup (no repo needed)
\draw[eD] (top.east)  -- (f5.west);
\draw[eD] (top.south) -- ++(0,-1.15) coordinate(bl) -- (bl -| ml.south) -- (ml.south);
\draw[eD] (bl -| mt.south) -- (mt.south);

% ================= EDGES: models -> adjudication
\foreach \m in {mh,mm,mg,mt,ml}{\draw[eR] (\m.east) -- (a1.west);}
\draw[eR] (a1) -- (a2);
\draw[eR] (a2) -- (a3);

% ================= legend
\node[font=\sffamily\scriptsize, text=black!70, align=left, anchor=north west]
  at ($(P1.south west)+(0,-1.75)$)
  {\textcolor{red!65}{\rule[0.4ex]{4mm}{0.7pt}} HINT lineage \quad
   \textcolor{orange!80!black}{\rule[0.4ex]{4mm}{0.7pt}} MEXA-CTP lineage \quad
   \textcolor{green!45!black}{\rule[0.4ex]{4mm}{0.7pt}} repair applied \quad
   \textcolor{black!45}{\rule[0.4ex]{4mm}{0.7pt}} benchmark data \quad
   \textcolor{blue!60}{\rule[0.4ex]{4mm}{0.7pt}} evaluated \qquad
   D5 repaired \& re-scored: $\Delta$ROC-AUC $=-0.0001$ ($p=0.93$) --- measurably inert};
\end{tikzpicture}
